suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent stopped during planning (Turns 10 and 12) due to missing visual content from previous turns (Turns 9 and 13). The fix is to instruct the Planner to explicitly extract the 'Children' section text from the visible HTML snippet or to scroll to the specific section before planning the next verification step, rather than relying on incomplete memory of the page content.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis incorrectly classifies the issue as 'incomplete_verification' caused by technical failures like timeouts. In reality, the trace shows the agent successfully loaded the pages (Turn 9, Turn 13) but failed to capture or scroll to the relevant information (children's section) before the Planner acted. The Planner's subsequent errors (Turns 10, 12) are logical consequences of the missing data from Turn 9/13, not independent technical failures. Therefore, the root cause is a failure in information extraction/scrolling strategy, not a system timeout.
